title: OpenWOP v2 corrections register
description: Shape of spec/v2/corrections.json (RFC 0197 §A.4). A W3C Process Class 3 correction — one that MAY affect conformance but adds no feature — MAY change a v2 shape outside the §A.2 retirement predicate only when nothing conforming stops conforming AND R3 holds for the prior shape (no committed v2 host bundle and no published registry manifest carries it). RFC 0255 §D adds a second class, `steward-deletion`, which MAY remove a v2 surface, including a required one, in a 2.x minor while no outside host exists; it records its census instead of requiring 0. This register is the machine-readable half of the COMPATIBILITY.md §3 entry: scripts/check-v2-retirement.mjs re-runs the bundle and registry scan over every row, so `priorShapeCensus` is a claim the gate falsifies rather than prose nobody re-reads. scripts/check-v2-surface-monotone.mjs admits a baseline removal whose pointer a row names. Data, not a wire artifact.

date.description: The date the correction landed, matching its COMPATIBILITY.md §3 entry.

class.description: `w3c-class-3`: a correction that adds no feature and whose prior shape nothing carried; a Class 2 editorial change moves no shape and needs no row, and anything else that invalidates a conforming document is a major (§A.1). `steward-deletion` (RFC 0255 §D): a steward removal of a v2 surface inside the major. It records the census whatever it finds, MUST NOT remove a reader for persisted data, MUST name its RFC, and a NEW row is refused while a tier-3 host is listed or a committed bundle comes from an unlisted origin (scripts/check-v2-retirement.mjs). Rows already published are never re-judged.

releasedIn.description: The corpus release that carried the correction.

rfc.description: The RFC under which the correction landed, or null when it landed under an already-Accepted RFC with no new filing.

pointers.description: Every schema pointer the correction moved, as `<repo-relative file>#<INSTANCE pointer>` — the document-shaped path scripts/generate-v2-surface-baseline.mjs prints (`#/signing`, `#/chains/[]/dag/nodes/[]/config`), never the schema-shaped one (`#/properties/signing`), because a `$defs` name is not a surface. scripts/check-v2-surface-monotone.mjs matches a baseline removal against this list, so a pointer left out is a removal the monotone gate refuses. An enum member is named by appending `=<member>` to its site (`schemas/v2/error-envelope.schema.json#/error=unknown_envelope_kind`); the bare site licenses every member under it, so name members when only some go.

compatibilityEntry.description: A literal substring of the COMPATIBILITY.md §3 "correction on record" entry, which is kept in docs/COMPATIBILITY-CORRECTIONS-LOG.md. The gate fails when it drifts — a register row whose prose entry has been reworded away is an unrecorded shape change.

priorShapeCensus.description: RFC 0197 R3, evaluated for the PRIOR shape at the time of the correction. scripts/check-v2-retirement.mjs re-measures `bundles` for every pointer whose surface the tree no longer has, and the typed value MUST equal the scan. A `w3c-class-3` row MUST count 0 on both legs; a `steward-deletion` row records what it finds. `manifests: null` is not an absence of evidence that may be read as evidence of absence — the gate refuses it.

bundles.description: Committed evidence/v2-host-bundles/*.json whose discovery.document carried the prior shape.

manifests.description: Published registry manifests that carried it. null means no census was run.

manifestsScanned.description: How many manifests the census read. A count of 0 out of 0 witnesses nothing.

note.description: How the census was taken and why nothing conforming stopped conforming.
